description: Main installer bootstrap script for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It performs environment checks, initializes dependencies, and handles incoming HTTP requests to set up or run the application.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: The main application kernel responsible for processing HTTP requests and generating responses.

methods.name: trimVersion
methods.description: Trims a version string to a specified number of version points (e.g., major.minor).

methods.name: isInSupportedPHPRange
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version falls within the supported range specified in system_requirements.php.
